Release checklist

Source: release.md

The steps of a regular CRAN release of the AMR package, as followed for v3.1.0 (October 2026). Replace X.Y.Z with the new version number. Copy this list into an issue or a note per release, or tick the boxes in a local copy.

1. Preparation (on the development version)

2. Version and documentation

3. Checks

4. Submission

5. After acceptance by CRAN

The pre-commit hook in .github/prehooks/ sets the version to X.Y.Z.9NNN and rewrites line 1 of NEWS.md on every commit to main. The release commit must therefore skip the hooks.

  • awk 'NR==1 {next} /^# AMR /{exit} 1' NEWS.md > notes.md
gh release create vX.Y.Z --target main --title "AMR vX.Y.Z" --notes-file notes.md --latest
rm notes.md
